status: REGISTERED before data collection; exploratory ad-discovery sessions preceding this study are labeled exploratory and are not study attempts
question: Can the native episode lifecycle cycle scored Hill Climb Racing episodes unattended across natural results, full-horizon truncation, revive/bonus offers and advertisements, without any unintended action?
hypothesis: In one unattended session of twelve consecutive attempts, at least ten attempts complete a full cycle (start -> gameplay -> natural result or governed truncation -> qualified score -> park at Tune or Paused) with zero unintended actions and zero manual interventions.
upgrades: reacquired from the Tune screen at session start and recorded in the run configuration; not assumed from Cycle 1

policies.schedule: attempt index even -> always_gas, odd -> random; scripted non-learning controls only
policies.purpose: natural terminations and full-horizon truncations must both occur; this is not a baseline study

ui_profile: configs/perception/hcr-reset-ui.json (version 2 chrome-aware profile; hash recorded per run)
terminal_classification: success_natural_scored: natural result, two agreeing fresh readings >=0.15 s apart, parked at Tune
success_truncated_scored: full 60 s horizon, verified paused readout valid, parked at Paused
success_unscored: parked at a stationary boundary but the score reader returned unknown
recoverable_failure: the adapter raised a bounded known failure and the session halted safely with pedals released
unknown_failure: an unknown UI state or advertisement stopped the adapter with no click
not_attempted: the session halted before this attempt index
measurements: foreground/geometry validation events and latched faults
pedal delivery: OS insertion count versus requested leases
stale captures discarded and stale watchdog releases
score-reader success per attempt (terminal and paused)
natural termination recognition latency and result animation waits
reset success and reset duration per attempt
advertisement encounters, phases, waits and legitimate closes
unknown-state incidence and its evidence frames
safe neutral release after every halt
unintended actions (any click outside the allowlisted named controls -> study fails)
primary_endpoint: longest run of consecutive successful cycles within a single session
secondary_endpoints: overall success fraction across all study sessions
advertisement handling: legitimate closes / advertisement encounters
median reset and advertisement overhead seconds
exclusion_rules: none after the fact; every attempt is reported with its terminal classification; a halted session reports remaining attempts as not_attempted
missingness_rules: unknown scores stay unknown; an unscored parked attempt is not a scored success
evidence: every attempt is a sealed canonical run record with per-frame observations, reset/terminal frames, menu, guard, capture and pedal traces
